svg.text: MPx-BLM-007/008/011 · Core can, heater block, vent standpipe
MPx Boil-Loop Mini v0.5 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. P07 can deep-drawn 0.6 or rolled + seam-welded; lid 0.6 press-fit, 3 tabs. Line inside with 3.0 aerogel blanket.
2. P08 bore Ø6.1 H8 for a Ø6 × 30 cartridge; groove R1.65 helical, pitch 4, 9.5 turns, depth 1.6.
3. P11 standpipe vents steam/CO₂ and returns warm-up overflow to the jug via the hook at the top.
4. KSD301 130 °C clipped to P08 flat (3 × 10 milled), TCO 152 °C in series, bonded with Kapton + paste.
Al 6061-T6 bar Ø22, turned; groove R1.65 RH pitch 4
